home.calls.body: Start a call from any conversation. Share a window or a whole screen, with its sound, at up to 60 frames a second. Guests join from a link with no account at all, and the call stays encrypted for them too.
home.calls.title: Call anyone, share anything
home.compare.ads: No ads, no upsell, no tiers
home.compare.selfHost: Run it on your own server
home.compare.title: What you get here
home.end.body: Make an account in about a minute. Bring your friends, or bring your own server.
home.express.body: Build your own emoji and sticker packs, share them with a link, and use them in every server and every message. Animated ones stay animated, for everyone, at no cost.
home.express.title: Your emoji, everywhere
home.foot.tagline: Nexa. End to end encrypted chat, voice and servers.
home.hero.fine: Free, with no tiers and nothing to upgrade.
home.hero.lede: Messages, calls and servers, encrypted on your device with keys the server never holds. Everything the paid tiers elsewhere are for is simply here.
home.hero.title: Chat that nobody else can read.
home.point.callsBody: Voice, video and screen share with sound, encrypted the whole way. Invite someone without an account with a guest link and they get the call and nothing else.
home.point.encryptedBody: Every message, file and call is encrypted on your device. The server keeps ciphertext it cannot read, and the keys never leave the people in the conversation.
home.point.fastBody: It opens fast, scrolls fast and stays connected when the window is closed to the tray, so a message never waits for you to look.
home.point.freeBody: Animated emoji, sticker packs, big uploads, long messages, HD screen share and groups without a size limit. There is no subscription, because there is nothing to sell you.
home.point.presenceBody: The desktop app picks up Rich Presence from your games and music, and passes it through to Discord as well. You do not have to choose.
home.point.yoursBody: One binary and one config file. Run it on your own machine, keep your own data, and let your friends in with an invite.
home.shot.app: A Nexa server, with a channel list, messages and the member list
home.shot.call: A voice call in Nexa with a screen share and camera tiles
home.shot.express: The emoji and sticker picker in Nexa
